-H.Name: -H
-H.description: If the -R option is specified, symbolic links on the command line are followed

-L.Name: -L
-L.description: If the -R option is specified, all symbolic links are followed

-P.Name: -P
-P.description: If the -R option is specified, no symbolic links are followed

-R.Name: -R
-R.description: Change the user ID and/or the group ID for the file hierarchies rooted in the files instead of just the files themselves

-f.Name: -f
-f.description: Don't report any failure to change file owner or group, nor modify the exit status to reflect such failures

-h.Name: -h
-h.description: If the file is a symbolic link, change the user ID and/or the group ID of the link itself

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Interpret user ID and group ID as numeric, avoiding name lookups

-v.Name: -v
-v.description: Cause chown to be verbose, showing files as the owner is modified
